question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
a_1=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{bmatrix},\quad a_2=\begin{bmatrix}-3 \\ -8 \\ 6\end{bmatrix},\quad a_3=\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ 5 \\ -3\end{bmatrix},\quad b=\begin{bmatrix}19 \\ 51 \\ -33\end{bmatrix}
$$

If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b,$ then what is $x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}x_1\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{bmatrix}+x_2\begin{bmatrix}-3 \\ -8 \\ 6\end{bmatrix}+x_3\begin{bmatrix}2 \\ 5 \\ -3\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}19 \\ 51 \\ -33\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} \\ 3 x_{1} \\ - 2 x_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}- 3 x_{2} \\ - 8 x_{2} \\ 6 x_{2}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}2 x_{3} \\ 5 x_{3} \\ - 3 x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}19 \\ 51 \\ -33\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} - 3 x_{2} + 2 x_{3} \\ 3 x_{1} - 8 x_{2} + 5 x_{3} \\ - 2 x_{1} + 6 x_{2} - 3 x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}19 \\ 51 \\ -33\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - 3 x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &=19 \\ 3 x_{1} - 8 x_{2} + 5 x_{3} &=51 \\ - 2 x_{1} + 6 x_{2} - 3 x_{3} &=-33\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -3 & 2 & 19 \\ 3 & -8 & 5 & 51 \\ -2 & 6 & -3 & -33\end{array}\right]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -3 & 2 & 19 \\ 3 & -8 & 5 & 51 \\ -2 & 6 & -3 & -33\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -3 & 2 & 19 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & -6 \\ -2 & 6 & -3 & -33\end{array}\right] && R_{2}:=R_{2}+(-3)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -3 & 2 & 19 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & -6 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 5\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(2)R_{1}\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - 3 x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &=19 \\ x_{2} - x_{3} &=-6 \\ x_{3} &=5\end{aligned}\right.
$$

From the third equation, we get $x_3=5.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get

$$
1x_2+(-1)(5)=-6\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_2=-1
$$

Finally, substituting these values into the first equation, we obtain

$$
x_1+(-3)(-1)+(2)(5)=19\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_1=6
$$

So, the solution of the system is $x_1=6$, $x_2=-1$, $x_3=5$, which means

$$
6a_1+(-1)a_2+(5)a_3=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}=(6)+(-1)+(5)=10.
$$

$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - 3 x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &=1 \\ 3 x_{1} - 8 x_{2} + 5 x_{3} &=-1 \\ - 2 x_{1} + 6 x_{2} - 3 x_{3} &=4\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -3 & 2 & 1 \\ 3 & -8 & 5 & -1 \\ -2 & 6 & -3 & 4\end{array}\right]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -3 & 2 & 1 \\ 3 & -8 & 5 & -1 \\ -2 & 6 & -3 & 4\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -3 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & -4 \\ -2 & 6 & -3 & 4\end{array}\right] && R_{2}:=R_{2}+(-3)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -3 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 6\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(2)R_{1}\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} - 3 x_{2} + 2 x_{3} &=1 \\ x_{2} - x_{3} &=-4 \\ x_{3} &=6\end{aligned}\right.
$$

$$
1x_2+(-1)(6)=-4\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_2=2
$$

Finally, substituting these values into the first equation, we obtain

$$
x_1+(-3)(2)+(2)(6)=1\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_1=-5

$$
-5a_1+(2)a_2+(6)a_3=b.
$$

$$
x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}=(-5)+(2)+(6)=3.

question.:question/problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
a_1=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{bmatrix},\quad a_2=\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -2 \\ 2\end{bmatrix},\quad a_3=\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ -11 \\ 1\end{bmatrix},\quad b=\begin{bmatrix}6 \\ -27 \\ -3\end{bmatrix}
$$

If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b,$ then what is $x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
If $x_1a_1+x_2a_2+x_3a_3=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}x_1\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}+x_2\begin{bmatrix}1 \\ -2 \\ 2\end{bmatrix}+x_3\begin{bmatrix}3 \\ -11 \\ 1\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}6 \\ -27 \\ -3\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} \\ 0 \\ x_{1}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}x_{2} \\ - 2 x_{2} \\ 2 x_{2}\end{bmatrix}+\begin{bmatrix}3 x_{3} \\ - 11 x_{3} \\ x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}6 \\ -27 \\ -3\end{bmatrix} \\ \begin{bmatrix}x_{1} + x_{2} + 3 x_{3} \\ - 2 x_{2} - 11 x_{3} \\ x_{1} + 2 x_{2} + x_{3}\end{bmatrix}&=\begin{bmatrix}6 \\ -27 \\ -3\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} + x_{2} + 3 x_{3} &=6 \\ - 2 x_{2} - 11 x_{3} &=-27 \\ x_{1} + 2 x_{2} + x_{3} &=-3\end{aligned}\right.
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 3 & 6 \\ 0 & -2 & -11 & -27 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 & -3\end{array}\right]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M&=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 3 & 6 \\ 0 & -2 & -11 & -27 \\ 1 & 2 & 1 & -3\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 3 & 6 \\ 0 & -2 & -11 & -27 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -9\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(-1)R_{1} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 3 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -9 \\ 0 & -2 & -11 & -27\end{array}\right] && R_{2}\leftrightarrow R_{3} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 3 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -9 \\ 0 & 0 & -15 & -45\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=R_{3}+(2)R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 3 & 6 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & -9 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 3\end{array}\right] && R_{3}:=(- \frac{1}{15})R_{3}\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} + x_{2} + 3 x_{3} &=6 \\ x_{2} - 2 x_{3} &=-9 \\ x_{3} &=3\end{aligned}\right.
$$

From the third equation, we get $x_3=3.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get

$$
1x_2+(-2)(3)=-9\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_2=-3
$$

Finally, substituting these values into the first equation, we obtain

$$
x_1+(1)(-3)+(3)(3)=6\quad\Rightarrow\quad x_1=0
$$

So, the solution of the system is $x_1=0$, $x_2=-3$, $x_3=3$, which means

$$
0a_1+(-3)a_2+(3)a_3=b.
$$

Consequently,

$$
x_{1} + x_{2} + x_{3}=(0)+(-3)+(3)=0.
$$
